name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-PRINTER3D
notes: Safe coordination boundary for native 3D-printing controllers. It checks Moonraker readiness, inspects slicer artifacts and matches profile evidence read-only, and now sends only fail-closed, SDK-gated real job commands (start/pause/resume/cancel) through Moonraker's own REST API - every command still passes the same evaluate_job() safety gate every bridge in this ecosystem uses. It never streams raw G-code and never replaces firmware, heater interlocks or motion authority - Moonraker/Klipper keep that.
